about.title: The National Prevention Engine
about.desc1: SPAG is not about treating diseases; it's about predicting and preventing them before symptoms ever appear.
about.desc2: By seamlessly collecting your everyday health data, SPAG runs it through our advanced AI risk engine to identify anomalies. If a risk is detected, the data is instantly bridged to your doctor's dashboard for preemptive action.

nutrisense.title: NutriSense
nutrisense.desc: Your daily nutrition and hydration intelligence layer. Tracks meal timing, hydration patterns, and converts lifestyle rhythm into long-term disease risk signals.

biometer.title: Urban Biometer
biometer.desc: Transforms cities into anonymous health sensing networks. Air quality, noise stress, traffic patterns, and crowdsourced biometrics — combined into real-time health heatmaps.

nutrisense.pattern_desc: You've skipped lunch 3 times this week. Metabolic risk score updated.
loop_steps: SPAG updates your metabolic risk profile

biometer.city_title: Your City Is Watching Over You
biometer.city_desc: SPAG's Urban Biometer turns anonymous city data into a personal health shield.
biometer.alert: Pollution hotspot detected on your usual route. Alternative path suggested.

cta.title: This is prevention intelligence. Not reaction.
cta.desc: SPAG is already learning. Your health data is already speaking.
cta.sub: NutriSense + Urban Biometer — active inside SPAG.
